Description

Crown Court 3 is the smallest piece in our Castle Crest series, a single castle tower in Knight Blue and Baby Blue with a pointed spire canopy and one straight slide. Seen from above, the play deck is octagonal, so children can step onto it from more than one side. It suits children aged 3 to 9, and play centres on climbing up and sliding down. The listing gives a capacity of 15 children and a product area of 9'2" x 12'5". With a safe play area of 15'2" x 18'5", it fits easily into a society garden or a nursery corner. Crown Court 3 carries a 3-year warranty on galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope. Share your site photos and we will place it on a layout drawing.

Activities

Climbing

Specifications

The tower frame is galvanised pipe, and the canopy, slide and panels are roto-moulded, so nothing on the outside depends on paint to stop rust. We install it self-standing or grouted, depending on your ground. Keep the 15'2" x 18'5" safe zone clear, give extra room at the slide exit, and check the canopy fixings during routine maintenance.

Warranty coverage

This warranty applies to Funplay’s products for the time periods described for each product type above and with the limitations described in this warranty. This warranty covers only defects in materials, production errors and structural integrity failures caused by defects in design, materials or manufacturing. Natural changes in wood over time are considered cosmetic issues and are not covered.

Installation Guidelines
Playground Equipment Installation Guidelines

Proper installation ensures the safety and longevity of our products. We offer two primary installation methods: self-standing and grouting. Follow these guidelines carefully to ensure a secure and stable installation.

Installation Methods
  • Self-Standing
  • In this method, the base plates of the equipment are directly fastened to the concrete surface using anchor bolts. This type of installation is generally done on podiums and terraces where the surface available is Plain Cement Concrete (PCC). Ensure minimum PCC thickness of 180 mm.
  • Grouting
  • This method is generally preferred when the proposed area is on ground level. Holes of approximately 1.5' x 1.5' x 1.5' (450 mm x 450 mm x 450 mm) are dug, and the equipment base pipes are placed in the holes. The holes are then filled with concrete to ensure a solid base.

Pre-Installation Guidelines

Before you begin the installation process, it's essential to follow these pre-installation guidelines to ensure a smooth and efficient setup:

  • Site Preparation
  • Ensure the proposed area is clear of any rocks, debris, or other obstructions.
  • Check that the site is correctly leveled.
  • Provide proper drainage to avoid accumulation of water.
  • Foundation Markings
  • Make accurate markings as per the foundation drawings provided.
  • Ensure the depth of PCC is as per the given standard depth.
  • Material Handling
  • Ensure proper material handling equipment is available on site.
  • Provide lifts in case the installation is on terraces or podiums.
  • Review Installation Drawings
  • Read the installation drawings provided to familiarize yourself with the installation methods.

Playground Equipment Installation Guidelines

Proper installation ensures the safety and longevity of our products. We offer two primary installation methods: self-standing and grouting. Follow these guidelines carefully to ensure a secure and stable installation.

Description

The 1 Seating Cum 2 Standing Twister puts three waist-twist stations on one frame: one for a seated user and two for people standing. Twisters turn the hips and waist from side to side while the user holds a handle, a gentle movement that suits older residents as well as regular walkers. Having seated and standing stations together means a senior citizen can sit while a friend or family member twists alongside. It is finished in Play Orange and belongs to our Fun Fitness range of outdoor gym equipment for parks, societies and walking tracks. We share the exact footprint and warranty terms with every quote. Our standard warranty terms give 3 years on galvanised pipes and 1 year on bearings. Ask us for a layout of your open gym.

Twisters rely on a rotating platform or seat, so the bearings are the main wear part and should be checked and greased at each service. We fix the twister frame self-standing or grouted, depending on the ground. Leave enough clear space around all three stations that people waiting do not stand inside the turning area.

Named after the twisting curve along its roof, the DNA Pergola is a walk-through garden structure. Wooden posts stand in two rows, and dark steel beams rise and fall in a wave above them, carrying wooden cross-slats that throw striped shade on the path below. Igloo Climber is a round frame of curved grey steel arches with a rope net stretched across the top and down the sides. The pads come in navy, orange, red and sky blue, and they give slightly under a child's weight, so children bounce, balance and jump from one pad to another. Spread across an open patch, the pads become stepping stones in a game of floor-is-lava or a chase between friends. The listed product area is 9'4" x 4', with a safe play area of 14'4" x 9'. Colour is listed as Multi Color. Galvanised pipe and roto-moulded parts have 3-year cover, and the springs carry 1 year under our standard warranty terms. Ask us to lay the pads out on your site drawing.

Each spring is bolted to a base plate that is grouted or fixed self-standing to a firm surface. Springs are the wearing part here, so check them for cracks, rust and pinch gaps at every service. Lay rubber flooring between the pads and keep the 14'4" x 9' zone clear so jumping children do not land on hard edges.

Description

Two ways up, one compact frame. The Net Rock Climber is an A-frame with a green rock wall on one face and a rope net on the other. Children pick the route that suits their confidence. The rock wall asks for careful foot placement on fixed holds, while the net moves under their weight and tests balance. Many children go up one side and down the other. Its footprint is only 5'3" x 4'7", with a safe play area of 10'3" x 9'7", which makes it a good fit for a society garden with limited space. The frame is finished in Lavender. Our warranty gives 3 years on galvanised pipe, composite laminates and play rope. Share your site photos and we will suggest where it goes.

Specifications

The A-frame is galvanised pipe, the climbing net is play rope and the rock face carries fixed holds. All of these sit under our 3-year warranty against manufacturing defects. Installation is self-standing or grouted. Check the net for wear and the holds for tightness as part of regular maintenance, and keep a soft surface on both sides of the frame.

Installation Guidelines
Playground Equipment Installation Guidelines

Proper installation ensures the safety and longevity of our products. We offer two primary installation methods: self-standing and grouting. Follow these guidelines carefully to ensure a secure and stable installation.

Installation Methods
  • Self-Standing
  • In this method, the base plates of the equipment are directly fastened to the concrete surface using anchor bolts. This type of installation is generally done on podiums and terraces where the surface available is Plain Cement Concrete (PCC). Ensure minimum PCC thickness of 180 mm.
  • Grouting
  • This method is generally preferred when the proposed area is on ground level. Holes of approximately 1.5' x 1.5' x 1.5' (450 mm x 450 mm x 450 mm) are dug, and the equipment base pipes are placed in the holes. The holes are then filled with concrete to ensure a solid base.

Before you begin the installation process, it's essential to follow these pre-installation guidelines to ensure a smooth and efficient setup:

  • Site Preparation
  • Ensure the proposed area is clear of any rocks, debris, or other obstructions.
  • Check that the site is correctly leveled.
  • Provide proper drainage to avoid accumulation of water.
  • Foundation Markings
  • Make accurate markings as per the foundation drawings provided.
  • Ensure the depth of PCC is as per the given standard depth.
  • Material Handling
  • Ensure proper material handling equipment is available on site.
  • Provide lifts in case the installation is on terraces or podiums.
  • Review Installation Drawings
  • Read the installation drawings provided to familiarize yourself with the installation methods.

data.description: Shaped like a dome and strung like a spider web, the Orbit Climber gives a group of children a rope frame they can climb from any side. There is no fixed route. It comes in Ocean Grey, a calm colour that sits well among trees or lawns. Play rope and galvanised pipe are covered by our 3-year warranty. Ask for a layout drawing showing the dome on your site.

Galvanised pipe on this frame carries a 3-year warranty. Send us your site plan and we will mark the safe play area for you.

Description

The S Bridge Climber bends its overhead ladder into an S curve, so children must change direction halfway across. The ladder is red and sits on yellow poles, with a side ladder at each end for getting up and down. Turning mid-crossing asks children to plan each reach and shift their body weight, which is harder than a straight run of bars. It covers 13' x 7'5", with a safe play area of 18' x 12'5". This climber gives older children a fresh challenge in a school ground or park where a plain monkey bar is already in place. Colours are Play Red and Play Yellow. Galvanised pipe on this frame carries a 3-year warranty. Send us your site plan and we will mark the safe play area for you.

Specifications

The S-shaped ladder and its supporting poles are galvanised steel, which resists rust in wet weather. It can be installed self-standing or grouted. Children can drop from points across the width of the curve. Cover the full 18' x 12'5" area with an impact-absorbing surface and check the joints at each bend during maintenance.

data.description: The Straight Net is a vertical rope net held in an upright frame, finished in New Black and Horizon Teal. Children climb the net face, swing a leg over the top and come down the other side. A rope net moves as they climb, so each step trains balance and grip together. It is a simple piece that works well for a school or society that wants to add climbing without giving up much ground. The safe play area is 10' x 5'2". Many buyers place it beside a slide or swing set to give children a short climbing station between rides. Galvanised pipe and play rope come with our 3-year warranty. Ask us how it fits alongside your existing equipment.

Children run around the platform to push it, so keep the full 12'5" circle clear and level, and grease or check the bearing as part of routine maintenance.

Description

The Deluxe Junior See Saw is a two-seat see saw with Knight Blue seats, built for one pair of children. It suits the 3 to 9 years Key User Group, so a pre-primary child and an older sibling can share it comfortably. Children take turns pushing off the ground, and they soon learn to match each other's timing, which makes it a good first lesson in cooperative play. The see saw measures 7' x 2'3" and needs a safe play area of 11' x 6'3". It is a sensible starting piece for a small society garden or a school play corner. This see saw has a galvanised steel beam and roto-moulded seats, so it handles monsoon rain without rusting. We set it up self-standing or grouted to suit your site. Lay rubber flooring under both seat ends where children land, and check the pivot and handle grips at every maintenance round.

Specifications

Steel hoops and the beam are galvanised, and the footrests are moulded to give a grip underfoot. We grout it or install it self-standing. Keep an impact-absorbing surface below both ends, check the hoops and footrests for loose fittings, and inspect the pivot bearing during routine maintenance.

Warranties

3 years warranty for Galvanized pipe, Roto molded parts, Composite laminates and Play rope.

1 years warranty for Springs, Bearings and Spare parts.

Warranty coverage

This warranty applies to Funplay’s products for the time periods described for each product type above and with the limitations described in this warranty. The warranty period applies from the date of purchase by the first customer. This warranty covers only defects in materials, production errors and structural integrity failures caused by defects in design, materials or manufacturing. Funplay’s liability under this warranty is limited to repair or replacement of defective products, without charge, at Funplay’s discretion.

Proper installation and maintenance

The warranty only applies if funplay’s products have been installed according to the instructions provided by Funplay and maintained correctly according to the Funplay Maintenance Manual. All warranty claims shall be accompanied by full documentation for proper installation and maintenance.

Warranty exclusions

This warranty does not cover any damage caused by accident, improper care, negligence, normal wear and tear, surface corrosion on metal parts, discolored surfaces and other cosmetic issues or failures due to misuse or vandalism. Natural changes in wood over time are considered cosmetic issues and are not covered.

Installation Guidelines
Playground Equipment Installation Guidelines

Proper installation ensures the safety and longevity of our products. We offer two primary installation methods: self-standing and grouting. Follow these guidelines carefully to ensure a secure and stable installation.

Installation Methods
  • Self-Standing
  • In this method, the base plates of the equipment are directly fastened to the concrete surface using anchor bolts. This type of installation is generally done on podiums and terraces where the surface available is Plain Cement Concrete (PCC). Ensure minimum PCC thickness of 180 mm.
  • Grouting
  • This method is generally preferred when the proposed area is on ground level. Holes of approximately 1.5' x 1.5' x 1.5' (450 mm x 450 mm x 450 mm) are dug, and the equipment base pipes are placed in the holes. The holes are then filled with concrete to ensure a solid base.

Pre-Installation Guidelines

Before you begin the installation process, it's essential to follow these pre-installation guidelines to ensure a smooth and efficient setup:

  • Site Preparation
  • Ensure the proposed area is clear of any rocks, debris, or other obstructions.
  • Check that the site is correctly leveled.
  • Provide proper drainage to avoid accumulation of water.
  • Foundation Markings
  • Make accurate markings as per the foundation drawings provided.
  • Ensure the depth of PCC is as per the given standard depth.
  • Material Handling
  • Ensure proper material handling equipment is available on site.
  • Provide lifts in case the installation is on terraces or podiums.
  • Review Installation Drawings
  • Read the installation drawings provided to familiarize yourself with the installation methods.

Triple Threat puts climbing, sliding, swinging and hopping into one robot-themed play station. Two robot-head towers are joined by a bridge, slides come down from the decks and a swing set is attached at one end. Key users are 5 to 12 years and the age group is 5+, which makes it a good match for a primary school or a society with plenty of school-going children. Warranties

3 years warranty for Galvanized pipe, Roto molded parts, Composite laminates and Play rope.

1 years warranty for Springs, Bearings and Spare parts.

Warranty coverage

This warranty applies to Funplay’s products for the time periods described for each product type above and with the limitations described in this warranty. The warranty period applies from the date of purchase by the first customer. This warranty covers only defects in materials, production errors and structural integrity failures caused by defects in design, materials or manufacturing. Funplay’s liability under this warranty is limited to repair or replacement of defective products, without charge, at Funplay’s discretion.

Proper installation and maintenance

The warranty only applies if funplay’s products have been installed according to the instructions provided by Funplay and maintained correctly according to the Funplay Maintenance Manual. All warranty claims shall be accompanied by full documentation for proper installation and maintenance.

Warranty exclusions

This warranty does not cover any damage caused by accident, improper care, negligence, normal wear and tear, surface corrosion on metal parts, discolored surfaces and other cosmetic issues or failures due to misuse or vandalism. Natural changes in wood over time are considered cosmetic issues and are not covered.

Installation Guidelines
Playground Equipment Installation Guidelines

Proper installation ensures the safety and longevity of our products. We offer two primary installation methods: self-standing and grouting. Follow these guidelines carefully to ensure a secure and stable installation.

Installation Methods
  • Self-Standing
  • In this method, the base plates of the equipment are directly fastened to the concrete surface using anchor bolts. This type of installation is generally done on podiums and terraces where the surface available is Plain Cement Concrete (PCC). Ensure minimum PCC thickness of 180 mm.
  • Grouting
  • This method is generally preferred when the proposed area is on ground level. Holes of approximately 1.5' x 1.5' x 1.5' (450 mm x 450 mm x 450 mm) are dug, and the equipment base pipes are placed in the holes. The holes are then filled with concrete to ensure a solid base.

Pre-Installation Guidelines

Before you begin the installation process, it's essential to follow these pre-installation guidelines to ensure a smooth and efficient setup:

  • Site Preparation
  • Ensure the proposed area is clear of any rocks, debris, or other obstructions.
  • Check that the site is correctly leveled.
  • Provide proper drainage to avoid accumulation of water.
  • Foundation Markings
  • Make accurate markings as per the foundation drawings provided.
  • Ensure the depth of PCC is as per the given standard depth.
  • Material Handling
  • Ensure proper material handling equipment is available on site.
  • Provide lifts in case the installation is on terraces or podiums.
  • Review Installation Drawings
  • Read the installation drawings provided to familiarize yourself with the installation methods.

Description

Lady Musance takes its name from music and dance. It is a concept installation shaped like a woman whose body is a guitar. In the drawings, a long slide curls down from her head and curved bars form her base, while a music note climbing wall and a harp-shaped climber stand nearby. Curved benches set around small lawns give room for casual singing, dancing and jamming, so adults use the area as much as children do. It is meant for a public park, a cultural centre or a large township garden that wants a landmark piece. As a concept, it has no standard size yet, and we develop the details with you, including age group and safe play area. When built, Lady Musance gets our 3-year warranty on the galvanised pipe, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope it uses. Contact us to discuss a project.

Lady Musance exists as drawings, so its structure, materials and foundations are worked out for your site after discussion. We choose self-standing or grouted installation once we see the ground. The slide exit and climbers need impact-absorbing surfaces, while the benches can sit on grass. Plan regular checks of the slide, climbing holds and bench fixings.

Installation Guidelines
Playground Equipment Installation Guidelines

Proper installation ensures the safety and longevity of our products. We offer two primary installation methods: self-standing and grouting. Follow these guidelines carefully to ensure a secure and stable installation.

Installation Methods
  • Self-Standing
  • In this method, the base plates of the equipment are directly fastened to the concrete surface using anchor bolts. This type of installation is generally done on podiums and terraces where the surface available is Plain Cement Concrete (PCC). Ensure minimum PCC thickness of 180 mm.
  • Grouting
  • This method is generally preferred when the proposed area is on ground level. Holes of approximately 1.5' x 1.5' x 1.5' (450 mm x 450 mm x 450 mm) are dug, and the equipment base pipes are placed in the holes. The holes are then filled with concrete to ensure a solid base.

Pre-Installation Guidelines

Before you begin the installation process, it's essential to follow these pre-installation guidelines to ensure a smooth and efficient setup:

  • Site Preparation
  • Ensure the proposed area is clear of any rocks, debris, or other obstructions.
  • Check that the site is correctly leveled.
  • Provide proper drainage to avoid accumulation of water.
  • Foundation Markings
  • Make accurate markings as per the foundation drawings provided.
  • Ensure the depth of PCC is as per the given standard depth.
  • Material Handling
  • Ensure proper material handling equipment is available on site.
  • Provide lifts in case the installation is on terraces or podiums.
  • Review Installation Drawings
  • Read the installation drawings provided to familiarize yourself with the installation methods.

Installation Guidelines
Playground Equipment Installation Guidelines

Proper installation ensures the safety and longevity of our products. We offer two primary installation methods: self-standing and grouting. Follow these guidelines carefully to ensure a secure and stable installation.

Installation Methods
  • Self-Standing
  • In this method, the base plates of the equipment are directly fastened to the concrete surface using anchor bolts. This type of installation is generally done on podiums and terraces where the surface available is Plain Cement Concrete (PCC). Ensure minimum PCC thickness of 180 mm.
  • Grouting
  • This method is generally preferred when the proposed area is on ground level. Holes of approximately 1.5' x 1.5' x 1.5' (450 mm x 450 mm x 450 mm) are dug, and the equipment base pipes are placed in the holes. The holes are then filled with concrete to ensure a solid base.

Pre-Installation Guidelines

Before you begin the installation process, it's essential to follow these pre-installation guidelines to ensure a smooth and efficient setup:

  • Site Preparation
  • Ensure the proposed area is clear of any rocks, debris, or other obstructions.
  • Check that the site is correctly leveled.
  • Provide proper drainage to avoid accumulation of water.
  • Foundation Markings
  • Make accurate markings as per the foundation drawings provided.
  • Ensure the depth of PCC is as per the given standard depth.
  • Material Handling
  • Ensure proper material handling equipment is available on site.
  • Provide lifts in case the installation is on terraces or podiums.
  • Review Installation Drawings
  • Read the installation drawings provided to familiarize yourself with the installation methods.

The round front opening leads into the tunnel, and a black wavy tail behind it doubles as a balance path. The teeth-shaped form gives small hands something to hang from. data.description: Paper Plane is a double-decker play tower styled as a folded paper plane. Red and purple wing platforms, star-shaped from above, sit either side of a central climbing net, and long Lemon Yellow slides bring children down. The two decks are slightly inclined, so children climb up the middle, choose a deck and slide off as if landing. It is designed for ages 5 to 12 and takes up to 15 children. The tower covers 24'4" x 12'2" and needs a safe play area of 30'4" x 16'2", which suits a long lawn or school ground. Play here builds arm strength, imagination and creativity. Galvanised pipe, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope carry a 3-year warranty. Write to sales@funplaysystems.com for a quote.

data.description: Bellatrix is a star-shaped geometric climbing frame in our Khel-Khud collection. Its grey and yellow frame has climbing discs, a disc ladder and a climbing net, with a Cherry Red slide on one side. Children can approach from any direction, so no two climbs are the same. Activities include climbing, hanging, balancing, rolling and sliding, and the open frame asks children to plan a route, which builds problem solving and strategy. It suits ages 5 to 12, holds up to 15 children, and needs a safe play area of 21'9" x 19'3". We cover the galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope for 3 years. Send us your site size and we will check the fit.

Installation Guidelines
Playground Equipment Installation Guidelines

Proper installation ensures the safety and longevity of our products. We offer two primary installation methods: self-standing and grouting. Follow these guidelines carefully to ensure a secure and stable installation.

Installation Methods
  • Self-Standing
  • In this method, the base plates of the equipment are directly fastened to the concrete surface using anchor bolts. This type of installation is generally done on podiums and terraces where the surface available is Plain Cement Concrete (PCC). Ensure minimum PCC thickness of 180 mm.
  • Grouting
  • This method is generally preferred when the proposed area is on ground level. Holes of approximately 1.5' x 1.5' x 1.5' (450 mm x 450 mm x 450 mm) are dug, and the equipment base pipes are placed in the holes. The holes are then filled with concrete to ensure a solid base.

Pre-Installation Guidelines

Before you begin the installation process, it's essential to follow these pre-installation guidelines to ensure a smooth and efficient setup:

  • Site Preparation
  • Ensure the proposed area is clear of any rocks, debris, or other obstructions.
  • Check that the site is correctly leveled.
  • Provide proper drainage to avoid accumulation of water.
  • Foundation Markings
  • Make accurate markings as per the foundation drawings provided.
  • Ensure the depth of PCC is as per the given standard depth.
  • Material Handling
  • Ensure proper material handling equipment is available on site.
  • Provide lifts in case the installation is on terraces or podiums.
  • Review Installation Drawings
  • Read the installation drawings provided to familiarize yourself with the installation methods.

data.description: Barrel Barrel is a play tower in the shape of a wooden barrel, with a Baby Blue wavy slide and a cage on top. Children climb in through an arch opening, up a rope net inside the barrel and out onto the top, then slide down. Blue climbing holds on the outside give a second way up. Parents can join in at the base, and the design invites play between children and adults. It suits ages 5 to 12. The tower is small, with a product area of 13'7" x 5'4" and a safe play area of 19'2" x 10'4". It builds arm strength, coordination and interactive play. Up to 15 children can use it at once, and the main structure carries a 3-year warranty. Tell us your corner size for a fit check.

data.description: Card Pyramid builds a house of playing cards at child scale. The triangular A-frame tower is Banana Yellow and red, with rope nets, a climbing wall and wavy holds on its faces. Children climb up one side, work out a route over the top and come down the other, which builds problem solving, strategy and body strength. There is sliding as well as climbing. The tower is narrow, with a product area of 12'7" x 3'11" and a safe play area of 17'7" x 8'11", and it takes up to 15 children aged 5 to 12. That slim shape lets a school fit it along a corridor of open ground. Its pipes, laminates and rope carry our 3-year warranty. Send us photos of the space.

Installation Guidelines
Playground Equipment Installation Guidelines

Proper installation ensures the safety and longevity of our products. We offer two primary installation methods: self-standing and grouting. Follow these guidelines carefully to ensure a secure and stable installation.

Installation Methods
  • Self-Standing
  • In this method, the base plates of the equipment are directly fastened to the concrete surface using anchor bolts. This type of installation is generally done on podiums and terraces where the surface available is Plain Cement Concrete (PCC). Ensure minimum PCC thickness of 180 mm.
  • Grouting

Side view of Pachkili green parrot tower with tunnel and climbing net

data.description: Pachkili is a parrot-faced play tower in yellow and green that works as a small circuit. Children climb a curved net climber, crawl through a tube tunnel and slide back down, then run round to start again. The name and the face come from the parrot, and the loop keeps children moving from one activity to the next. Up to 15 children aged 5 to 12 can play on it. At 13'4" x 4'5", with a safe play area of 18'4" x 8'5", it is narrow enough for a side lawn or a school corridor of open ground. Climbing and crawling build upper body strength and spatial awareness. data.description: Paheli is a puzzle-themed play structure where jigsaw pieces become the climbing route. data.description: Sway is a two-seat swing on an A-frame, with Knight Blue legs and a Cherry Red top beam. Moulded caps sit on top of the legs, and two flat seats hang from the beam on chains. Swings travel well beyond their frame, so the safe play area is larger, at 16'3" x 11'10". Plan that space before choosing a spot, and keep footpaths away from the front and back of the seats. Sway belongs to the Pinnacle series of our NexLev range and can stand beside any of its towers. The galvanised frame and moulded parts have a 3-year warranty, and bearings and spare parts have 1 year. Ask us for a drawing with the swing zone marked.

That compact size lets a school or society add a serious climbing piece without giving up much ground. Listed skills are cognitive development, motor skills and self control. It comes in mixed colours. Vertex's galvanised pipe and play rope come with a 3-year warranty. Send us a photo of the spot you have in mind.

Installation Guidelines
Playground Equipment Installation Guidelines

Proper installation ensures the safety and longevity of our products. We offer two primary installation methods: self-standing and grouting. Follow these guidelines carefully to ensure a secure and stable installation.

Installation Methods
  • Self-Standing
  • In this method, the base plates of the equipment are directly fastened to the concrete surface using anchor bolts. This type of installation is generally done on podiums and terraces where the surface available is Plain Cement Concrete (PCC). Ensure minimum PCC thickness of 180 mm.
  • Grouting
  • This method is generally preferred when the proposed area is on ground level. Holes of approximately 1.5' x 1.5' x 1.5' (450 mm x 450 mm x 450 mm) are dug, and the equipment base pipes are placed in the holes. The holes are then filled with concrete to ensure a solid base.

Pre-Installation Guidelines

Before you begin the installation process, it's essential to follow these pre-installation guidelines to ensure a smooth and efficient setup:

  • Site Preparation
  • Ensure the proposed area is clear of any rocks, debris, or other obstructions.
  • Check that the site is correctly leveled.
  • Provide proper drainage to avoid accumulation of water.
  • Foundation Markings
  • Make accurate markings as per the foundation drawings provided.
  • Ensure the depth of PCC is as per the given standard depth.
  • Material Handling
  • Ensure proper material handling equipment is available on site.
  • Provide lifts in case the installation is on terraces or podiums.
  • Review Installation Drawings
  • Read the installation drawings provided to familiarize yourself with the installation methods.

data.description: Toss is a two-seat see saw with a brown beam, Mango Yellow seats and a tyre stop under each end. The tyres take the knock when a seat comes down, which makes the ride softer for both children. The beam is narrow, 7'11" x 1'5" in all, so Toss slips into a play area that is already quite full. Its safe play area is 12'11" x 5'5". Two children ride at a time, and keeping the rhythm going builds concentration and confidence. It belongs to the Woody series and matches the brown finish of its other pieces. The galvanised pipe and moulded seats have a 3-year warranty, with 1 year on bearings and spare parts. Tell us how many children use the area at a time and we will suggest a mix.

Description

Woody Go Round is a merry-go-round with a round wooden platform and hand rails in Mango Yellow and Cherry Red. Children hold the rails, push off with their feet, then jump on and ride, taking turns to push. It suits 4 to 8 children at a time. The platform covers 5'9" x 5'9" and the safe play area is 8'9" x 8'9", which keeps a clear ring around the spinning edge. That small footprint lets you add it to a society play area or a school ground without redrawing the whole layout. The listed skills are self control and confidence building. Galvanised pipe and laminates on it are covered for 3 years, and the bearing for 1 year. Ask us for a quote with the spinning zone shown.

Age Group NA
Activities
Sliding

Specifications

The central bearing takes the load of every ride, so check it at each service as per our maintenance steps. Woody Go Round is installed self-standing or grouted, and it must be set level so it turns evenly. Lay impact flooring right around the platform and keep the 8'9" x 8'9" ring clear.

Warranties

3 years warranty for Galvanized pipe, Roto molded parts, Composite laminates and Play rope.

1 years warranty for Springs, Bearings and Spare parts.

Warranty coverage

This warranty applies to Funplay’s products for the time periods described for each product type above and with the limitations described in this warranty. The warranty period applies from the date of purchase by the first customer. This warranty covers only defects in materials, production errors and structural integrity failures caused by defects in design, materials or manufacturing. Funplay’s liability under this warranty is limited to repair or replacement of defective products, without charge, at Funplay’s discretion.

Proper installation and maintenance

The warranty only applies if funplay’s products have been installed according to the instructions provided by Funplay and maintained correctly according to the Funplay Maintenance Manual. All warranty claims shall be accompanied by full documentation for proper installation and maintenance.

Warranty exclusions

This warranty does not cover any damage caused by accident, improper care, negligence, normal wear and tear, surface corrosion on metal parts, discolored surfaces and other cosmetic issues or failures due to misuse or vandalism. Natural changes in wood over time are considered cosmetic issues and are not covered.

Installation Guidelines
Playground Equipment Installation Guidelines

Proper installation ensures the safety and longevity of our products. We offer two primary installation methods: self-standing and grouting. Follow these guidelines carefully to ensure a secure and stable installation.

Installation Methods
  • Self-Standing
  • In this method, the base plates of the equipment are directly fastened to the concrete surface using anchor bolts. This type of installation is generally done on podiums and terraces where the surface available is Plain Cement Concrete (PCC). Ensure minimum PCC thickness of 180 mm.
  • Grouting
  • This method is generally preferred when the proposed area is on ground level. Holes of approximately 1.5' x 1.5' x 1.5' (450 mm x 450 mm x 450 mm) are dug, and the equipment base pipes are placed in the holes. The holes are then filled with concrete to ensure a solid base.

Pre-Installation Guidelines

Before you begin the installation process, it's essential to follow these pre-installation guidelines to ensure a smooth and efficient setup:

  • Site Preparation
  • Ensure the proposed area is clear of any rocks, debris, or other obstructions.
  • Check that the site is correctly leveled.
  • Provide proper drainage to avoid accumulation of water.
  • Foundation Markings
  • Make accurate markings as per the foundation drawings provided.
  • Ensure the depth of PCC is as per the given standard depth.
  • Material Handling
  • Ensure proper material handling equipment is available on site.
  • Provide lifts in case the installation is on terraces or podiums.
  • Review Installation Drawings
  • Read the installation drawings provided to familiarize yourself with the installation methods.
